## Checklist

- [ ] A behaviour change bumps the plugin's `version` in `manifest.toml` and adds a `== X.Y.Z ==`
      entry on top of its `CHANGELOG.txt`, in plain sentences.
- [ ] `python scripts/check.py` passes.
- [ ] A new listing in the default registry declares an SPDX licence, a source repository and an
      issue tracker, and the plugin never installs or changes other plugins or ebookerr itself.
